results.question: How many orders are currently in transit to the customer?
What is our net revenue?
How many active customers do we have?
results.sql:
-- "Active" is not defined in the schema, so this assumes an active customer is one who has placed at least one order.
SELECT COUNT(*) AS active_customers
FROM customers
WHERE number_of_orders > 0;

results.question: How many customers have placed more than 3 orders?
What is the total amount paid by gift card across all orders?
results.sql:
SELECT SUM(gift_card_amount) AS total_gift_card_amount
FROM orders;
